decisions.reason: The sheet preparation module builds on the core portfolio and kept its own dedicated page through 2024, which signals ongoing commercial relevance as a supporting module in the firm's automated finishing lines.

The folding add-on unit is close to the established offer and has a documented customer installation combining creasing, perforating, cutting and folding in one pass, but it is only mentioned on the website rather than featured, which leaves some risk that it is phased out.
